title: Equivalence of toral Chern-Simons and Reshetikhin-Turaev theories
summary: We prove a natural isomorphism between toral Chern-Simons theory with gauge group $\mathbb T=\mathfrak t/Λ\cong U(1)^n$ and the Reshetikhin-Turaev theory associated with the finite quadratic module determined by an even, integral, nondegenerate symmetric bilinear form $K:Λ\timesΛ\to\mathbb Z.$ More precisely, let $G_K=Λ^*/KΛ$ be the discriminant group of $K$, equipped with its induced quadratic form $q_K$, and let $C(G_K,q_K)$ be the corresponding pointed modular category.
